title: 厚烤奶油 Ham 三明治

issues.description: Aligned the two breads and eggs with a two-serving yield, measured the ham, and removed the unexplained cream drizzle. Text review covered the final zh-TW, en, ja, and ko article bodies. Recipe time, yield, and sensory results still require kitchen verification; no trial evidence or restaurant provenance is claimed.
